title: Protective effects of minocycline on dermal fibroblast cells from oxidant and apoptotic effects of H(2)O(2): A comprehensive analysis with Raman spectroscopy and data-driven approach.
authors: Sezer, Gulay; Sahin, Furkan; Celik, Nusret; Onses, Mustafa Serdar
journal: Spectrochimica acta. Part A, Molecular and biomolecular spectroscopy
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨米诺环素对过氧化氢诱导的成纤维细胞氧化损伤的保护作用，使用拉曼光谱和机器学习分类，但核心是细胞氧化应激与凋亡，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Minocycline (Mino) is an antibiotic with neuroprotective, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. This study investigated the protective effects of Mino against hydrogen peroxide (H(2)O(2))-induced oxidative damage in dermal fibroblast cells and analyzed these effects using Raman spectroscopy, principal component analysis (PCA), and machine learning (ML). L929 fibroblast cells were evaluated using MTT and scratch wound-healing assays. The production of reactive oxygen species (ROS) and the process of apoptosis were evaluated through the use of 2',7'-dichlorofluorescein diacetate (DCFH-DA) and Annexin V labelling, respectively. The mRNA expression levels of Nrf2, Hmox1, Nqo1, and Col1a were analyzed through quantitative real-time polymerase chain reaction (qRT-PCR). Raman spectroscopy detected molecular alterations, while PCA and ML classified spectral variations. Mino reduced H(2)O(2)-induced cellular toxicity, ROS levels, and apoptosis while enhancing fibroblast migration. It significantly upregulated Nrf2 and Hmox1 mRNA under oxidative stress and increased Col1a expression when applied alone. Raman spectroscopy revealed biochemical changes in lipids, proteins, and nucleic acids. PCA distinguished treatment groups, showing Mino-treated cells closely resembled controls. The SVM attained 90.10 % classification accuracy, underscoring the efficacy of Raman-based computational analysis. The findings collectively highlight the potential of Raman spectroscopy, PCA, and ML as a sensitive, label-free approach for monitoring molecular changes, thereby supporting the therapeutic potential of Mino in oxidative stress-related therapies.
abstract_zh: 米诺环素（Minocycline, Mino）是一种具有神经保护、抗炎和抗氧化特性的抗生素。本研究探讨了Mino对过氧化氢（H(2)O(2)）诱导的真皮成纤维细胞氧化损伤的保护作用，并利用拉曼光谱（Raman spectroscopy）、主成分分析（principal component analysis, PCA）和机器学习（machine learning, ML）分析了这些效应。通过MTT和划痕愈合实验评估了L929成纤维细胞。活性氧（reactive oxygen species, ROS）的产生和细胞凋亡过程分别通过2',7'-二氯荧光素二乙酸酯（DCFH-DA）和Annexin V标记进行评估。通过定量实时聚合酶链反应（quantitative real-time polymerase chain reaction, qRT-PCR）分析了Nrf2、Hmox1、Nqo1和Col1a的mRNA表达水平。拉曼光谱检测了分子变化，而PCA和ML对光谱变异进行了分类。Mino降低了H(2)O(2)诱导的细胞毒性、ROS水平和细胞凋亡，同时增强了成纤维细胞迁移。在氧化应激条件下，它显著上调了Nrf2和Hmox1 mRNA，并在单独应用时增加了Col1a表达。拉曼光谱揭示了脂质、蛋白质和核酸的生化变化。PCA区分了处理组，显示Mino处理的细胞与对照组高度相似。SVM达到了90.10%的分类准确率，突显了基于拉曼的计算分析的有效性。这些发现共同强调了拉曼光谱、PCA和ML作为灵敏、无标记方法监测分子变化的潜力，从而支持Mino在氧化应激相关疗法中的治疗潜力。
